quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes CSV/HTML import, preview blank-click deselection, multi-select relative X/Y movement and relative rotation, Japanese/English UI switching with browser-language detection and English fallback, off-canvas edit preview visibility with clipped export, text fit-to-box, rotation handle hover/drag affordance, image import, layer editing, and WebP export. Cross-browser, real-device, and very large font storage edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, and browser-local custom font storage.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, user guide is present, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested improvements passed: blank-click deselection, relative multi-layer movement/rotation, Japanese/English UI switching, off-canvas edit visibility, text fit-to-box, rotation handle affordance, and QCDS evidence update. Remaining satisfaction risk is broader real-user font files, template variety, and non-Chromium browser coverage.

runtimeGate.requirement: Chrome or headless browser confirms nonblank render, primary elements, and primary operations.
checks: generated CSV evidence for relative edits
